Client discovery call — invoice automation opportunity.

Participants: Alex (Client IT), Sam (Borek Solutions).

Alex: We process about twelve thousand invoices per month manually in SAP.
Sam: What is the biggest pain point today?
Alex: Three-way matching takes four days on average and errors require rework.
Sam: Which systems are in scope?
Alex: SAP ERP, our document management system, and email approvals.
Sam: What does success look like in year one?
Alex: Cut processing time by fifty percent and eliminate duplicate payments.
Alex: Compliance requires a full audit trail for every automated decision.
